eligibility_rule: simple atomic or diatomic adsorbate and tractable elementary surface diffusion coordinate
well-defined low-index surface and published microscopic dynamics
published PES/barrier/first-principles evidence sufficient to establish feasibility
a plausible dissipation observable or an informative reason that a scalar dissipation mapping may fail
published evidence is openly accessible or its final publication identity and usable public copy/abstract are independently verifiable
selection does not use chi, expected SymC agreement, residual size, or closeness of any barrier/rate prediction
exposure_note: Exploratory literature outcomes for some candidates were already known before this formal pool. This is prospective with respect to new computation and ChemSA classification, not outcome-blind literature selection.
purpose: Select a contrast/limit system using neutral methodological axes, never expected ChemSA agreement or chi.

selection_rule.primary: maximize the count of true contrast axes A-D among eligible candidates
selection_rule.tiebreak: for tied highest-score candidates, compute SHA256(seed + '|' + candidate_id) and choose the lexicographically smallest hexadecimal digest
